[FACT — Villain Pluribus (BB) range behind the equity above: Pre-flop: called a middle-position open → BB defending range (~17% of hands); Flop: raise (~114% pot) → polarized: top 22% value + bottom 9% bluffs; Turn: bet (~100% pot) → polarized: top 30% value + bottom 15% bluffs; River: check → range unchanged.]

[HEURISTIC — Equity REALIZATION (raw equity discounted for hero's position + hand class; ESTIMATED, not exact): flop ~49% → realized ~43% (IP, a weak draw); turn ~28% → realized ~25% (IP, a weak draw); river ~80% → realized ~100% (IP, a strong made hand). A marginal hand out of position rarely realizes its raw equity; a strong made hand over-realizes. Weigh the continue / bluff-catch read against the REALIZED figure, not the raw one — but this is heuristic context: a decisive pot-odds price FACT and the hard equity FACT above still take precedence.]

[HEURISTIC — SPR & COMMITMENT (effective stack ÷ pot, hero-centric; ESTIMATED, not exact): flop SPR ~19.6 — to get all-in profitably needs ~49% equity (high SPR — favours pot control with one-pair hands); turn SPR ~3.5 — to get all-in profitably needs ~44% equity (medium SPR — strength-dependent); river SPR ~0.8 — to get all-in profitably needs ~31% equity (very low SPR — hero is near-committed). The stack-off % is the equity to get all-in profitably versus a willing range, NOT hero's pot-odds price.
